The '''third battle of DS 5''' was a conflict during the [[Battle for Honor]] campaign during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]], an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] officer who defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], attempted to resupply at the Rebel outpost [[DS 5]]. Hunting him down, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces [[Raid near DS 5|raided]] the supplies being shipped in to the Rebel outpost, and later [[Attack on the DS 5 convoy|destroyed]] several cargo vessels on their way there. He was leading the effort to take him out along with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to get revenge on Harkov for killing his mentor earlier, Admiral [[Mordon (Human)|Mordon]]. Time came for a direct raid against [[Admiral Harkov's fleet]].

==The battle==
Imperial forces stranded Harkov's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']] following the successful interdiction of the Rebel supply convoy. Imperial leaders chose this time to eliminate Harkov's fighter screen of [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]]. Keeping the pressure on, [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboat]] pilots from Mu integrated themselves into fresh TIE Avenger starfighters, leveling the playing field against Harkov's relentless waves of Avengers in previous missions. Avengers Mu returned to the system near platform DS 5 with orders to destroy as many enemy TIE Avengers as possible, at least fifty percent of Harkov's squadrons, to pave the way for the next phase of the attack. Agents of the [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Secret Order of the Emperor]] had instructed at least one pilot from group Mu to inspect any transport craft that may enter the system, hoping to establish Harkov's exact location.

Imperial pilots noticed two [[Cargo ferry|cargo ferries]] designated [[Badger (cargo ferry)|''Badger'']] laying a minefield around DS 5 as they squared off with incoming Avengers from [[H-Beta Squadron (TIE/ad)|H-Beta Squadron]]. In the moments to follow, Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] collided in a maelstrom of missile and laser fire. Having finished the minefield, Harkov's Cargo Ferries entered hyperspace as rogue and loyalist TIE Avengers continued their furious dogfight. As loyalist starfighter pilots gained the upper hand, a single fighter disengaged to inspect the new arrival from the ''Protector''s hangar. Emerging from the ''Protector'' the shuttle ''[[Toten]]'' headed to platform DS 5, while the ''Protector'' subsequently prepped its hyperdrive engines. Avenger ''Mu 2'' passed shuttle ''Toten'' just before it entered the hangar, revealing Harkov was inside. Imperial fighters had successfully eliminated the required first half of Harkov's Avengers as two Alliance [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvettes]] ''[[Wurger]]'' arrived. ''Mu 2'' again diverted to inspect ''Wurger 1'' and ''2'', moreover upon discovering troops aboard, ''Mu 2'' proceeded to destroy corvettes ''Wurger'' single-handedly. With the successful destruction of countless Avengers and corvettes ''Wurger'', Imperial starfighters left the system to prepare for the final assault.

==Aftermath==
The engagement delivered heavy damaged to Harkov's traitorous contingent. Following the battle, loyalist Imperial forces mounted a [[Capture of DS 5|final attack]] against Harkov and his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. It saw the capture of the admiral and the destruction of much of his fleet.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle occurred in [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], a 1994 computer game.
